channel.title: GreenCompute Research
channel.description: Independent research on decarbonized digital infrastructure: zero-water direct-to-chip cooling, renewable baseload PPAs, and statutory energy codes.

item.title: Operational Directory: 100% Renewable & Closed-Loop Facilities
item.description: Verified global directory of zero-water cooled, 100% solar, wind, and geothermal hyperscale data centers: Moro Hub, Microsoft sealed builds, Verne Global, SINES, Lefdal, and Google St. Ghislain.

item.title: Thermodynamics of Closed-Loop Cooling: Direct-to-Chip & Dry Coolers
item.description: Engineering analysis of closed-circuit liquid cooling, dry coolers, technology cooling systems, and an interactive PUE/WUE water-energy impact calculator.

item.title: International Legal Frameworks & Government Mandates
item.description: Comparative legal analysis of statutory energy efficiency and renewable mandates: Germany EnEfG §11, Singapore DC-CFA2, Ireland CRU LEU, and EU EED 2023/1791.

item.title: Clean Baseload Power: Nuclear PPAs, SMRs, & FERC Jurisprudence
item.description: Technical analysis of behind-the-meter nuclear colocation, the Crane Clean Energy Center (TMI-1) restart, Kairos SMRs, and FERC Docket ER24-2172.

item.title: Source Index & Regulatory Docket Repository
item.description: Master bibliographic repository of primary statutes, regulatory filings, engineering standards, and investigative news documentation.
